en.title: Count Subarrays Whose Remainder Equals Their Length
en.description:
Count the non-empty contiguous subarrays whose element sum, taken modulo k as a non-negative remainder, equals exactly the subarray length. Under the original numeric constraints elements may be equal, and identity does not affect the sum.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k; the second line contains the elements. 1≤n≤200000; 1≤elements,k≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: For prefix sums S, define the key (S[i]−i) mod k. A valid subarray needs equal keys at both ends and a length strictly less than k; count with a frequency table of earlier prefixes restricted by length.
